status: Specified before fresh development and evaluation; local timestamped freeze, not external preregistration
worlds: Eight factorial worlds: ordinary bias constant/one sign reversal; forcing g zero/nonzero; reference bias d zero/nonzero. Ninth descriptive no_bias world b=d=g=0. Nonzero g,d constant from t=0. Policies assume g=0; scalar correction assumes d=0. No true world label supplied.
change_time: Uniform integer 8..47 inclusive, independently generated before noise. Same latent time per paired seed across change worlds; no-change worlds ignore it.
rng: One NumPy default_rng(seed); draw x0,b0,forcing sign,reference sign,tau,then eps[60],eta[60],w[60]. All draws before policy; same draws paired across worlds and policies.

common_scalar_update.rule: After paid z, fast iff abs(y-z-h)>2*sqrt(ph+RY+RZ). New h=(1-alpha)h+alpha*(y-z), ph=(1-alpha)^2*ph+alpha^2*(RY+RZ). Inflate ph by qh each t>0. State estimate y-h, with current-y-reuse-aware plug-in variance on update. Common rule inherited from prior audit; prior variance adjusted to new b0 distribution.

gates.confidence: Buy iff .25*[ph+RY-((1-.2)^2*(ph+RY)+.2^2*RZ)]>.02 and budget remains. No compute cost in current study.
gates.innovation: Always buy at0. Each t>0 form r=y_t-.8*y_prev-u_prev-.2*h before current reference update, standardized by sqrt(QX+(1+.8^2)*RY+.2^2*ph). Latch max abs standardized residual since last opportunity. At an opportunity buy if latch exceeds threshold and budget remains. Clear latch at every opportunity, including declined. This is a heuristic score, not exact conditional innovation variance.
gates.hybrid: Protect0,25,55. At remaining opportunities, same innovation gate, but at most3 discretionary purchases. Protected purchases cannot be consumed early.
gates.anchor_filter: Descriptive benchmark only: three-state Gaussian moment estimate (x,b,d), known g=0, initial mean0 covariance diag(1,1,.0625), A=diag(.8,1,1), Q=diag(.0025,qb,0), y H=(1,1,0), z H=(1,0,1). Same periodic six references. No causal attribution of benchmark difference solely to access.

loss: sum(x_next^2+.05*u^2)+.02*number of paid references. No monetary compute price, energy, memory, or physical latency model. Monitor evaluations counted; timing end-to-end simulation only. Compare gate performance under free computation, not cognitive efficiency.
selection: Choose threshold for innovation and hybrid separately from [1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5], and anchor qb from [0,.0025,.04], minimizing mean loss over eight equally weighted factorial worlds on development only. Periodic/confidence and shared scalar update fixed. No_bias excluded from selection.
primary: Three gate-minus-confidence paired differences in total loss, averaged within seed over 4 change worlds and separately 4 constant worlds: six prespecified tests. Normal-approximation Bonferroni familywise95% CI across6; practical margin .02. Seed is independent unit; world and time are not independent replications.
secondary: Individual world contrasts, postchange first reference delay/fraction observed, state-recovery delay/fraction, no-change alarm and purchase counts, estimation/relative-bias errors, forecast90% coverage/width, descriptive anchor benchmark, timing distributions. Descriptive95% intervals; no discovery claims from cherry-picked cells.
access_delay: First purchase t>=tau minus tau; censor missing at60-tau and report missing fraction. Opportunities occur before action at t. This measures sample arrival, not detection or correct interpretation.
recovery: First completed five-consecutive post-action states |x_next|<=.2 after tau, delay j+5; censor at60-tau and report fraction. Only change worlds. Transient, target-dependent, potentially ill-suited under forcing; secondary only.
alarm: For innovation/hybrid only count every t>0 score>selected threshold, whether latch already set or budget exhausted. In no-change worlds these are no-change alarms, not automatically false statistical discoveries; persistent initial calibration error/forcing/reference bias can cause model discrepancy.
forecast: Normal(.8*xhat+u,.64*v+.0025), g assumed0. Plug-in variance for scalar adaptive audit, Gaussian moment for anchor; check coverage empirically, no calibration guarantee.
freeze: Hash runner, anchor_filter, protocol, selected parameters before evaluation. Archive selection scores and immutable raw evaluation.
examples: Prespecified seed30000 only; no handpicked success traces.
scope: Synthetic restricted algorithms with known target0; no consciousness, brain, or human efficacy inference. Stochastic factorial has known priors and is not the unrestricted shift-closed nonidentifiability class.
